children: The European Central Bank will be working on new swap lines for foreign central banks to help them borrow euros and strengthen the single currency, ECB President Christine Lagarde said on Monday.
"We will be working on swap lines that will be more responsive to the imperative of having a sovereign euro area and a strong euro," Lagarde told European lawmakers.
